data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate returns, before expenses, that are commensurate with theperformance of the NYSE FANG+ Total Return Index, subject to tracking error and forex movement. The Scheme does notguarantee or assure any returns.
data.asset_allocation: Securities included in the NYSE FANG+ Index - 95% to 100% (High) Money market instruments / debt securities,Instruments and/or units of schemes of domestic Mutual Funds. - 0% to 5% (Low to Medium)
